summary: Frontend-only validation of the new Member Identity Card feature. All 13 UI checks PASS: protected-route redirect, secretary persona login, /members loads 7 seeded rows, member detail opens, 'View Identity Card' button (data-testid='view-card-btn') navigates to /members/:id/card, card-front and card-back both render with all required content (MPCA branding, name, UID, category, sub-category, enrolled date, valid-till, photograph placeholder/initials, terms text, signature line, barcode strip, issued date, Hon. Secretary label, Holkar Stadium footer), Print and Back-to-Member toolbar buttons visible, Back-to-Member returns to /members/:id. Regression check: nav-public-disclosures and nav-dashboard sidebar links still navigate correctly with no errors.

issues: Cosmetic only: BarcodeStrip in MemberCard.jsx uses an inline JSX key (`key={i}`) which is acceptable but could be made deterministic via UID+index — non-blocking. The card preview spacing between front and back is generous on screen but @page A4 print rules look correct.

critical_code_review_comments: MemberCard.jsx imports lucide-react 'User' but does not use it — minor dead import.

MemberCard.jsx assumes member.name is always non-empty when computing initials and signature dots; a defensive fallback (e.g., name?.split(' ') ?? []) would prevent runtime errors if a malformed member slips through.

Issued-on date is computed at render time via `new Date().toLocaleDateString` — the card therefore shows TODAY's date, not the actual card-issuance date. For a production identity card this should be persisted on the member record (issued_on) when first generated so reprints stay consistent. Flag for Phase 2.

Print uses native window.print() which works, but the in-page <style> block injecting @media print rules could be moved to index.css alongside the .mpca-card classes to avoid re-injecting on every mount.
Validity ('Lifetime' / member.effectiveness) is shown verbatim — consider validating/normalising this string before printing on a physical card.
test_credentials: Demo persona login via localStorage 'mpca_persona'. Used persona-secretary-card for the run.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded member MPCA-PAT-0001 (Shri Devendra Bundela).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Card route is /members/:id/card; key data-testids: view-card-btn (on MemberDetail), member-card-page, card-front, card-back, print-card-btn, card-back-btn. Protected via ProtectedShell — direct goto redirects to /login. Page uses print:hidden to hide toolbar+header during window.print(). No backend changes were needed for this feature.
rca of the issue: No defects found. First test pass appeared to fail because the script clicked the secretary persona via wait_for_url('**/dashboard') and then page.goto('/members') with a short timeout — the member list API hadn't returned yet (0 rows observed). Re-running with sidebar nav + 3s settle wait produced 7 rows and all subsequent assertions passed.
